description: This file defines a custom layout manager class AttachmentsPreviewGridManager used for managing grid layouts in RecyclerView, specifically for handling the presentation of attachment previews in a grid with configurable spans.

classes.name: AttachmentsPreviewGridManager
classes.description: A custom GridLayoutManager that manages span allocation for attachment preview items in a RecyclerView grid.

methods.name: attachToRecyclerView
methods.description: Inherited method to attach this layout manager to a RecyclerView.

methods.name: checkLayoutParams
methods.description: Overrides the method to set item height based on span count.

methods.name: allocateSpans
methods.description: Calculates and assigns span sizes for items based on their position and the total item count.
